name: Dataprep Holdings Bhd
overview: Dataprep Holdings Berhad 今年主要动作是拟以 RM3.0 million 出售 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的 60% 股权，从而退出支付解决方案业务；同时公司完成了一项私下配售，发行 104,218,000 股新股，筹集约 RM11.0 million。此外，公司收到 Widad Builders Sdn Bhd 提交的 RM1,258,556.02 清盘呈请，但公司表示预计不会对集团造成重大财务或运营影响。
overview_en: Dataprep Holdings Berhad's main corporate action this year was the proposed disposal of a 60% equity interest in Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. to Mr. Ng Chee Chau for RM3.0 million, exiting the payment solutions business. The company also completed a private placement of 104,218,000 new shares, raising approximately RM11.0 million in gross proceeds.

segments.name: 支付解决方案与服务
segments.note: 公司拟出售该业务子公司 60% 股权，交易完成后将不再控股该支付业务。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to dispose of 60% equity interest in its payment solutions subsidiary, and will cease to control the payment business upon completion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述出售事项发布补充资料。
actions.text_en: The company released additional information on the proposed disposal.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司与 Mr. Ng Chee Chau 签订股份出售协议，以 RM3.0 million 现金出售 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 60% 股权（9,540,600 股普通股）。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a share sale agreement with Mr. Ng Chee Chau to dispose of 60% equity interest (9,540,600 ordinary shares) in Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. for RM3.0 million cash.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面完成私下配售集资，并收到清盘呈请。
segments.note_en: At the company level, the private placement was completed and a winding-up petition was received.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 23 日收到 Widad Builders Sdn Bhd 提交的清盘呈请，申索金额 RM1,258,556.02；公司表示预计不会对集团造成重大财务或运营影响。
actions.text_en: The company received a winding-up petition from Widad Builders Sdn Bhd on 23 November 2026 claiming RM1,258,556.02; the company stated it does not expect any material financial or operational impact on the Group.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售于 2026 年 5 月 22 日视为完成，共发行 104,218,000 股配售股份，筹集总毛额约 RM11.0 million。
actions.text_en: The private placement was deemed completed on 22 May 2026, with 104,218,000 placement shares issued, raising total gross proceeds of approximately RM11.0 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售支付解决方案子公司 Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd. 的 60% 股权，交易完成后将退出对该支付业务的控制。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of 60% equity interest in its payment solutions subsidiary Dataprep Payment Solutions Sdn. Bhd., and will exit control of the payment business upon completion.
